corrections.before: A visual approach is an ATC authorization foraircrafit on IFR flight plan to proceed visually to the airport, even to the landing. It is not an instrument approach procedure, and there is no missed approach segment. Even when an aircraft is being vectored for an instrument approach, controllers may initiate or pilots may request a visual approach provided the pilot subsequently reports the airport or runway in sight. Before clearing an aircraft for a visual approach, controllers should ensure that weather conditions at the airport are VFR, and they need resolve potential conflicts with all other aircraft. The pilot must, at all times, have either the airport or the preceding aircraft in sight. This approach must be authorized and under the control of the appropriate air traffic control facility. Reported weather at the airport must be ceiling at or above 1000 ft, and visibility of 3 miles or greater. An aircraft unable to complete visual approach shall be handled as any "go around", and appropriate separation must be provided.

Because the man was wearing sunglasses and a seeing eye dog was lying quietly underneath the seat in front of him. corrections.before: 一位男士乘坐飞机从西雅图飞往旧金山，途中飞机突然在萨克拉门托降落。乘务员向乘客解释了情况，并告诉他们可以在起飞前下飞机活动50分钟。乘客们依次下飞机，但有一位乘客没走。当男士经过这位乘客时，他注意到这位乘客是盲人。因为他戴着墨镜，一只导盲犬安静地躺在他前方的座位下。这位盲人肯定经常乘坐这趟航班，因为飞行员能够直接叫出他的名字。飞行员问他："Keith,我们将在萨克拉门托停留一小时，你想下飞机活动一下吗?"这位盲人拒绝了，但他问飞行员是否可以带他的导盲犬散个步。但飞行员不知道的是，门口的乘客在看到他时全都停下了，因为他在下飞机时戴着墨镜并牵着一只导盲犬。这引发了乘客们的恐慌，他们以为飞行员是个盲人。乘客们不仅想更换航班，而且还想更换航空公司!飞行员和乘务员花了一段时间向乘客解释情况并让大家冷静下来，之后飞机再次起飞了。

corrections.before: 一次飞行中，有位来自南非、富有的中年白人女士对自己的座位不满意，因为她发现自己的座位在一位黑人男士旁边，她向乘务员要求换座位。乘务员询问换座位的原因，这让她更加烦躁：“你看不到吗?你们让我坐在黑人旁边，我不能坐在这么恶心的人旁边，给我换个座位!"乘务员很难解决这个问题，因为飞机几乎客满，但她还是告诉女士她会查询公务舱或头等舱是否有空位。几分钟后，乘务员带回了好消息。经济舱和公务舱全部客满，但头等舱还有一个座位。乘务员说到这里时，那位女士禁不住自鸣得意地笑着看向周围的人。乘务员接着说到：“这种情况下通常不会给乘客升舱，然而机长刚才有特别许可，他不能接受我们的乘客要被迫坐在讨厌的人身边。"然后她对女士身边的乘客说：“所以如果您愿意收拾行李，我们已为您准备好座位。"周围的乘客全部起立鼓掌，黑人乘客换到了飞机前部的座位。

Controllers should know that non-local pilots only navigate according to charted features. To avoid accidents, local knowledge should be taken seriously.

corrections.before: An air traffic controller issued a take-off clearance to the Flight 386 for runway 30R.At the same time, an airport operations officer was operating a vehicle on that runway. The controller had previously issued a clearance to the operations officer to conduct bird dispersal activities on the runway. The operations officer was monitoring his radio and heard Flight 386's take-off clearance. He told the controller that he would vacate the runway. At the same time, the flight crew had observed the vehicle on the runway and did not commence the takeoff. The controller cancelled the take-off clearance until the runway was clear. According to the examination of the wreckage, investigators analyzed that there's no evidence of an explosion or pilot error.

corrections.before: On August 14, 2005 at approximately 12:00 p.m local Greek time, a Boeing 737-300, crashed into rolling terrain northeast of Athens, Greece. The aircraft had departed Larnaka Airport, Cyprus, two hours and 57 minutes prior to the accident. According to the investigation, during climb-out as the aircraft passed 12, 000 feet, the cabin altitude warning horn sounded. Thecaptain then began radio communications with his company maintenance base at Larnaka. The aircraft was on autopilot at the time and followed its FMCS inserted route. Itsubsequently entered the missed approach holding pattern. Two Air Force F-16 fighter aircraft intercepted the aircraft emergency call and one of the pilots noticed that the captain's seat was empty and the first officer's seat was occupied by an incapacitated person. Shortly thereafter, one person was seen to enter the cockpit wearing an oxygen mask. After 1 hour and 12 minutes in the holding pattern the left engine flamed out due to fuel starvation and 10 minutes later the right engine also flamed out. Greek authorities suggested the failure of pressurization in the aircraft may have caused the crash when they ruled out a terrorist attack.

corrections.after: An Eastar Jet B737 performing flight from Korea to Japan, was cleared for the approach to runway 03L. However, the aircraft was aligned with runway 03R. corrections.after: A flight from Philippines to Singapore with 129 people on board, was descending towards Singapore when the flight crew donned their oxygen masks and declared PAN PAN, reporting excessive cabin altitude, and initiated an emergency descent to 9000 feet.
